description: This source file defines the interface 'ThingSearchQueryCommand', which aggregates all commands related to querying the Search service within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures for setting namespaces and retrieving optional filters, and extends a base 'ThingSearchCommand'.

classes.name: ThingSearchQueryCommand
classes.description: An interface that aggregates commands for querying the Search service, defining methods to set namespaces and get filters.

methods.name: setNamespaces
methods.description: Sets the given namespaces on a copy of this command and returns it.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves an optional filter string for the search query.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, specifically 'QUERY' for this interface.
